fields.Name: Common: Directory People Per Day
fields.UserQuestion: How many people were added on each of the last seven business days?
fields.Description: The directory dashboard's "people added" bars: one row with a count for each of the last seven business days, today first.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: one row. PeopleAddedD0 (today) to PeopleAddedD6: vwPeople rows whose __mj_CreatedAt falls on that business day, by fnBusinessDayOf against fnBusinessToday().Today (the BizApps business time zone). fnBusinessDayOf runs only on rows created in the last eight days. Separate from Common: Directory Dashboard Summary because fnBusinessDayOf cannot be inlined, which makes any statement that calls it single-threaded. No template parameters.
